prompts: Use case: scientific-educational. Generate one transparent cutout exercise illustration for a fitness carousel. Input 1 is the CHARACTER APPEARANCE reference only: pale warm gray muscular bald man wearing black sunglasses, black shorts and black trainers, smooth shaded anatomy, orange-red active muscles. Input 2 is the MACHINE AND POSE reference only. Draw the character performing a chest-supported plate-loaded T-bar row in the BOTTOM stretch position: full body straight diagonal from feet left to head right, chest touching angled pad but upper chest slightly above its top edge, arms straight reaching down to neutral grip handles, shoulder blades protracted, upper-back muscles highlighted muted coral #E5725C. Match machine geometry in pose reference: long lever pivot by feet, weight plates at front right, large angled chest pad, foot platform left, black steel frame. Three-quarter side view like reference, entire body and entire machine visible with generous margin. No writing, symbols, logo, arrows or background. Preserve character appearance from input1; do not copy masked black character or blue background from input2.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied exercise illustration into the TOP contraction of the same chest-supported T-bar row. Keep exactly the same pale gray bald sunglasses character, black shorts, shoes, muted coral upper-back highlights, exact same machine, camera and feet. Bend elbows back and lift handles and plate-loaded lever toward lower chest. Chest stays fixed to the pad, spine neutral, shoulder blades retracted. Full machine and figure remain visible. Also remove ALL surrounding glow, vignette, backdrop and shadow haze; output a clean transparent PNG with fully transparent empty area everywhere outside the man and machine. No text, no arrows, no labels. No glow.

Use case: scientific-educational. Edit this illustration to demonstrate the small end-of-set scapular retraction movement on a chest-supported T-bar row, with BOTH ELBOWS STILL FULLY STRAIGHT. Keep exact camera, character, machine, feet and chest on pad. Draw shoulders pulled backward toward spine and together, without bending elbows. Hands and loaded lever rise only a small distance because shoulder blades retract. This is NOT a full row: elbows locked straight, no elbow flexion. Pale gray bald man with black sunglasses, black shorts/shoes, coral upper back. Preserve transparent background and full machine. No text, symbols or arrows. No background, glow or shadow.
